messages:
Ravi CSM: Morning folks — starting the Sentinel Retail onboarding thread. Need to lock stakeholders, measurable success criteria, and a conservative 30-day plan. Who's the main contact on your side?
Lina AE: Marco is the product lead; looping him in. Marco, can you confirm primary dev contact + any blackout dates next 2 weeks?
Marco (Sentinel Retail): Hi all, dev is Jin (cc'ed). No blackout dates. Priority is getting search embeddings live for our storefront demo.
Jin Eng: Thanks Marco. My focus will be API integration and embedding pipeline. Will need sample dataset and access to a dev key.
Ravi CSM: Proposed success metrics (quantitative):
- Store search embeddings indexed and returning top-5 within 200ms (avg)
- Demo flows: 4 concurrent demo users with P95 latency < 700ms
- Telemetry: integration logs + error rates reported to our console by day 10
- Customer satisfaction: internal beta testers rate relevance >= 4/5 at day 21
Qualitative: simple admin docs + 1 recorded enablement session. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Lina AE: Add renewal-risk trigger: if telemetry not onboarded by day 10, flag AM+CS weekly sync.
Marco (Sentinel Retail): Can we add an SLA on embedding freshness? Need updates within 30 minutes of content change.
Jin Eng: We can do near-real-time sync; will confirm approx lag after seeing dataset size.
Feedback Bot: Feedback form created: https://forms.redwood.example.com/sentinel-feedback — use for daily user scoring.
Ravi CSM: Access checklist: 
- Create service account, store key in vault (team: sentinel-eng)
- Grant read/write to dev sandbox index
- Provide sample CSV/JSON lines (1000 rows) for embeddings testing
Jin Eng: I'll request the service account today. Please give exact scopes.
Ravi CSM: Scopes: embeddings.write, generate.read, logs.emit. Share via vault and DM me when posted.
Lina AE: Quick integration sample for Jin's team:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Authorization: Bearer $SRV_KEY
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "embed-retail-1",
  "input": ["product title here"]
}
```
Jin Eng: That looks good. I'll run local tests once key is in vault.
Ravi CSM: Proposed 30-day timeline (conservative):
- Day 0: kickoff + roles confirmed
- Day 2: service account requested & sample data shared
- Day 5: dev sandbox access + baseline embedding run
- Day 12: telemetry ingestion and basic dashboards
- Day 18: eval prompts run & qualitative feedback capture
- Day 25: canary traffic to prod index (limited)
- Day 30: production pilot review + exec summary
Marco (Sentinel Retail): Timeline looks good. If day 2 slips, please push slack updates.
Ravi CSM: Risk register (initial):
- Delay getting service account (mitigation: AE to escalate to IT)
- Unexpected data schema differences (mitigation: small POC dataset first)
- Relevance below threshold (mitigation: iterate prompts and embedding params)
Lina AE: I'll escalate to Marco's IT if we don't see service account request in 48h.
Ravi CSM: Enablement plan: 45-min recorded walkthrough + 1 Pager admin guide + office hours week of Day 14.
Feedback Bot: Reminder scheduled: daily feedback check-in at 13:00 PT (until Day 21).
Jin Eng: Action items: request service account (today); run baseline embedding test (after creds).
Marco (Sentinel Retail): Action items: share PII policy and sample product feed by EOD.
Lina AE: Action items: intro email to IT contact and keep the escalation channel open.
Ravi CSM: I'll publish the kickoff doc and checklists after this call and post link here. Thanks everyone — meeting invite sent for 11am PT (follow-up). :white_check_mark:
